input_format: bounded raw HTTP/2 HEADERS frame followed by optional CONTINUATION frames
configuration_profile: real HTTP/2 frame dispatch, HEADERS state, stream/request creation, HPACK request-header processing and minimal fuzz.test virtual host
allocator_mode: fresh HTTP/2, stream and request pools per input
justification: NGX-IF17 starts after HEADERS framing and supplies an already-live synthetic stream. This target exercises the real frame-header dispatch, HEADERS metadata parsing and ngx_http_v2_create_stream before decoding request headers.
state: A bounded frame sequence enters ngx_http_v2_state_head. The real HEADERS handler validates metadata, allocates a stream/request, and the HPACK state machine consumes required CONTINUATION frames, checking frame type, matching stream ID and END_HEADERS. Request execution remains disabled in the isolated fuzz build.
known_limitations: The first frame must be HEADERS; input is capped at 8192 bytes and nginx receives a contiguous writable copy, so socket read fragmentation is covered by NGX-IF15.
Malformed header errors are captured before request finalization and posted-event processing.
The request stops before ngx_http_v2_run_request, routing, body handling, and application phases.

scopes.contract: Parse bounded HEADERS/CONTINUATION sequences, validate frame metadata and sequencing, create a live request stream and decode/process HPACK fields, including authority virtual-host selection.
scopes.preconditions: One contiguous input buffer, first frame HEADERS, bounded to 8192 bytes, fresh pools, initialized nginx modules, and minimal core/v2 configuration.
